rule: High wind = any DFW-area airport gust 58 mph+ (NWS severe) or a measured 58 mph+ gust or wind damage report from NWS Fort Worth in the service area, backed by a second station or a report. Strong = 50 mph+ airport gust.
sources: NWS ASOS airport observations via Iowa Environmental Mesonet
NWS Fort Worth local storm reports via Iowa Environmental Mesonet
